abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: CHA-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Magic Versatility
abilities.description: Out of combat, know all utility spells from all classes of a level you have access to. Costs 2x spell level from magic pool.

abilities.name: Born Entertainer
abilities.description: Performer: +half prof to STR/DEX/CHA checks, prof in Acrobatics and Performance. Entertainer: +half prof to INT/WIS/CHA checks, prof in Persuasion and Performance.

abilities.name: Charming
abilities.description: Subtract X from saving throws vs your charming spells, or add X to persuasion/seduction/deception checks. Uses: 2x CHA modifier.

abilities.name: Performer's Dynamic
abilities.description: Gain X more mana per level (retroactive).

abilities.name: Befuddle
abilities.description: Consume one Charming use to subtract that value from a foe's next attack/check/save/damage roll.

abilities.name: I'm Just the Bard
abilities.description: Persuasion check vs group resolve. On success: considered out of combat until end of next turn or hostile action. Once per turn.

abilities.name: Experienced Entertainer
abilities.description: Once per long rest, turn a failed Acrobatics/Performance/Persuasion check into a success.

abilities.name: Improved Performance
abilities.description: Pick another proficient ability. Pick one already proficient: proficiency cap increases to 16, proficiency dice auto-roll 2.

abilities.name: Charming (1d10)
abilities.description: Charming die upgraded to 1d10.

abilities.name: Mesmerising Presence
abilities.description: In-combat persuade/seduce attempts have disadvantage but don't auto-fail. 'I'm just the bard' has advantage and costs 0 AP.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: CHA-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Powerful Song
abilities.description: Increase spell range by 30ft. Uses: CHA modifier per rest.

abilities.name: Unexpected Symphony
abilities.description: First-time damage to a target deals additional same-type damage. Resets if target was sleeping.

abilities.name: Awake From Slumber
abilities.description: Empower a spell to auto-crit on sleeping targets. Doubles mana cost.

abilities.name: Calm Sleep
abilities.description: Force sleeping targets damaged by your spell to remain sleeping. Uses: CHA modifier.

abilities.name: Fade Away
abilities.description: On thunder damage: consume 50 mana to force CONST save or target falls asleep 1 turn. AoE: +25 mana per additional target.

abilities.name: Critical Melody
abilities.description: On spell crit, deal true damage instead. Uses: CHA modifier per short rest.

abilities.name: Artist of the Veil
abilities.description: Leftover AP can prepare a spell as a reaction next round. Casting teleports you up to 60ft.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: CHA-based spellcasting.

abilities.name: War Chant
abilities.description: Harm: ranged attack for [spell mod + 4 + 1d12] damage, +4/level. Enhance: ally's next damage instance increased by same amount. Scaling: at song upgrade milestones, +[spell mod + 1d12].

abilities.name: Battle Resonance - Soothing Harmony
abilities.description: When applying a buff to an ally, can also heal that ally for [(level-1)d6].

abilities.name: Inspire
abilities.description: Inspire an ally to add X to one check/save/attack/damage roll. Uses: 2x CHA modifier.

abilities.name: Joy of Music
abilities.description: When buffing an ally with a spell, also apply the buff to yourself. Uses: CHA modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Preferred Song
abilities.description: Mind: 1 min cast, allies in 60ft regain 30% max mana. Body: 1 min cast, allies in 60ft regain 50% max HP. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Transcendent Frisson
abilities.description: Reaction: add 1d6 to attack/save, 1d6x5 to skill checks, or (level/3 rounded up)d6 to damage. Gain 1 charge at lvl 4, +1 per level. Recharge on rest.

abilities.name: Mantra Concentration
abilities.description: Concentrate on up to X mantras simultaneously. Pay AP cost of first only.

abilities.name: Chorus Of Mantras
abilities.description: Concentrate on up to X mantras simultaneously.

abilities.name: Mantra Focus
abilities.description: Advantage on WILL checks to maintain concentration on mantras.

abilities.name: Legendary Song
abilities.description: All mantra effects are doubled (if applicable).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based spellcasting.

abilities.name: Divine Sight
abilities.description: See holy/unholy/cursed creatures and objects through non-material walls.

abilities.name: Divine Smite
abilities.description: Once per turn, add [level-1]d6 true damage to a single-target attack or spell.

abilities.name: Divine Protection
abilities.description: Greater Good: grant ally within 5ft [2d8] temp HP, +1d8/level. Sacred Vessel: gain [2d10] temp HP at end of turn.

abilities.name: Heroic Aura
abilities.description: Allies within 20ft gain X additional PA and MA. Blocks 10% of max mana.

abilities.name: Duality
abilities.description: Can have 2 auras active simultaneously.

abilities.name: Godly Presence
abilities.description: Can have unlimited auras active at once.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Divine Aid
abilities.description: Religion check to ask god for minimal assistance. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Expend 1 Might charge to heal ally within 90ft for [3x level d6].

abilities.name: Might of the Faithful
abilities.description: Charges equal to proficiency. Restored on rest. Can use feats multiple times per turn.

abilities.name: Healing Grace
abilities.description: First heal per turn increased by [4d6], +2d6 per level. Can split among AoE targets or focus on one.

abilities.name: Life Flow
abilities.description: Whenever healing allies, they regain X additional HP.

abilities.name: Requital of the Devoted
abilities.description: If all AP spent healing below-max-HP allies: gain free effect (Escape/Retaliate/Defend). 2 effects at 14, 3 at 17.

abilities.name: Godly Healing
abilities.description: All healing dice auto-max (e.g. 4d10 = 40).

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.description: Once per long rest, ask god for aid. God appears as spectral avatar. 0 AP.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Sense the Unholy
abilities.description: Sense exact location of all unholy creatures within 150ft (no material walls, not hidden).

abilities.name: Chain the Unholy
abilities.description: All unholy within 100ft make STR save or be snared by chains of light until next turn. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Banish Minor Curse
abilities.description: Remove one shadow/unholy minor curse. Once per long rest, 60ft range.

abilities.name: Radiant Healing
abilities.description: Healing an ally also deals Xd10 light damage to closest enemy within 10ft (pierces armor).

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.description: Force unholy being out of a host. WILL save. Once per long rest, 10ft.

abilities.name: Banish Medium Curse
abilities.description: Remove non-major curse/seal. Once per long rest, 60ft.

abilities.name: Godly Awareness
abilities.description: Sense all unholy in 1 mile, know info/location. Advantage on possession saves. 10 min duration. Uses: WILL mod per long rest.

abilities.name: Banish Major Curse
abilities.description: Remove any curse or seal. Once per long rest, 60ft.

abilities.name: Banish Darkness
abilities.description: Exorcism works on willing hosts. Successful exorcism deals 50d10 light damage to the creature.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WIS-based spellcasting.

abilities.name: Animal Protector
abilities.description: Animals are friendly/neutral. Advantage on Animal Handling. Lost if you harm animals without cause.

abilities.name: Cycle of Life
abilities.description: 4-step cycle: receive damage → heal ally → apply negative effect → deal damage. Each step grants a bonus. Resets after completing all 4.

abilities.name: Wildwalker
abilities.description: Add proficiency to survival and perception checks in wilderness.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: On single-target damage: force STR save or rooted 1 turn. Uses: WIS modifier.

abilities.name: Nature's Embrace
abilities.description: Out of combat: channel 1 min to heal allies an additional 10% max HP.

abilities.name: Cycle of Life (Enhanced)
abilities.description: After completing cycle, WIS modifier doubled and DEX/STR doubled for attack/damage until end of next turn.

abilities.name: Spur Trees
abilities.description: Animate a tree for one action: melee attack (greataxe damage, crushing) or speak. Uses your WIS mod as STR and your proficiency.

abilities.name: Nature's Regeneration
abilities.description: On natural ground: heal 10% max HP at start of turn. Doubled if you took damage. Can transfer to ally for 1 AP.

abilities.name: Animate Tree
abilities.description: Animate a tree for 1 minute. It can attack, grapple, throw rocks. Acts after you. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Restored Body
abilities.description: On death: absorbed by nature and reborn at dawn in nearest forest. Resets death stacks. Body becomes plant-based.

abilities.name: Natural Defence
abilities.description: AC = 10 + CONST mod + DEX mod. PA and MA are 0.

abilities.name: Minor Shapeshift
abilities.description: Transform into learned animal forms. Learn up to 4 animals. Up to 1 hour cumulated between long rests. Shapeshift HP = half total HP.

abilities.name: Minor Animalistic Adaptation
abilities.description: Choose 2 of: horns, claws, scales, tail, quills, feline reflexes. Each grants a unique combat ability.

abilities.name: Primal Regeneration
abilities.description: Double healing from short rests. Need food/water every 2 days instead of daily.

abilities.name: Advanced Shapeshift
abilities.description: Learn 4 more animals. Shapeshift up to 4 hours between long rests.

abilities.name: Advanced Animalistic Adaptation
abilities.description: Choose 2 of: gills, spider legs, goat legs, dragon wings, digging claw.

abilities.name: Predatory Assault
abilities.description: Advantage on stealth to sneak. Auto-crit on surprised targets in animal form or with animalistic attacks.

abilities.name: Greater Shapeshift
abilities.description: Learn 4 more animals. No time limit on shapeshift.

abilities.name: Greater Animalistic Adaptation
abilities.description: Choose 1 of: dragon head, medusa eyes, tentacle, reflective hide, elephant trunk.

abilities.name: Metamorph
abilities.description: Choose one more minor, medium, and greater adaptation. Double shapeshifting HP pool.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WIS-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description: 90-degree cone 15ft. Push enemies 10ft on failed CONST save. Uses: WIS modifier.

abilities.name: Electrify
abilities.description: On lightning damage: mark target (10 mana). Next turn, lightning damage consumes mark for +1d10. Some spells have special electrify interactions.

abilities.name: Lightning Force
abilities.description: On lightning damage: deal bonus lightning damage (ignores armor) to additional targets within 5ft.

abilities.name: Focused Channelling
abilities.description: While channelling: resistant to all damage (except true), advantage on WILL saves to maintain.

abilities.name: Lightning Blast
abilities.description: Ignore lightning resistance for next spell/attack. Uses: WIS modifier.

abilities.name: Perfect Channelling
abilities.description: Cannot be interrupted by damage while channelling. Advantage on CC saves while channelling. MA doubled while channelling.

abilities.name: Stormbring
abilities.description: Channel a 4000ft radius storm. 8th-level lightning bolts every turn at every target (up to 50). Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Natural Defense
abilities.description: AC = 10 + DEX mod + CONST mod. PA and MA are 0.

abilities.name: Rage
abilities.description: Advantage on STR saves/lifting. Resist physical damage. AC +X, STR weapon +Y damage (halved dual wield). 3 turns.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.description: Killing a target auto-enters/extends rage and resets raging attacks.

abilities.name: Expert Fighter
abilities.description: Add proficiency to grapple, shove, etc.

abilities.name: Fury Pool
abilities.description: While raging: deal damage → roll 1d6 → add to pool. Below 0 or above 10: rage ends + 2d10 true damage/level. Spend on: Rampart, Cleave, Debilitating Force, Obliterate.

abilities.name: Frenzy Instincts (Minor)
abilities.description: Choose 1 per rage: Savage Accuracy, Hardened Rage, Provoking Presence, Mutilating Wrath.

abilities.name: Frenzy Instincts (Medium)
abilities.description: Choose 1 per rage: Hot-Headed, Bloodlust, Relentless Fury, Vault of Ire.

abilities.name: Fury Pool (Advanced)
abilities.description: New abilities: Acidic Wrath, Savage Restoration, Anguished Devastation, Concuss.

abilities.name: Ravaging Fury
abilities.description: Activate rage as reaction to being attacked. Melee attacker makes CONST save or knocked prone and attack fails.

abilities.name: Raging Attacks (2)
abilities.description: Earthquake Smash (60ft leap, 15ft AoE), Vampiric Slashes, Power Blow.

abilities.name: Frenzy Instincts (Major)
abilities.description: Choose 1 per rage: taunt on attacks, -1 AP weapon attacks, survive lethal damage.

abilities.name: Ultimate Rage
abilities.description: Choose as many rage upgrades as you want when raging.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WIS-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: Embedded Weapon
abilities.description: Can use WIS modifier for attack and damage rolls instead of STR.

abilities.name: Vanguard Aegis
abilities.description: Shield abilities fueled by taunt stacks. Fortify (temp HP), Breach (corroded), Exhaust (weakened). Limited uses per rest.

abilities.name: Get Down
abilities.description: Reaction: become target of a projectile aimed at ally within 5ft. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Living Bastion
abilities.description: Max HP +12, +[3 x new level] HP per level up.

abilities.name: Throw Shield
abilities.description: Throw shield 20ft. Attack roll, [3 x PA] crushing damage. Must retrieve.

abilities.name: Walking Bastion
abilities.description: Choose per level: +1 AC, +5 PA, or +3 HP/level.

abilities.name: Reflective Barrier
abilities.description: Double PA for 2 turns. Ranged weapon attacks reflected to attacker. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Bouncing Shield
abilities.description: Shield throw bounces to nearest foe within 10ft. Consume 10 mana to return shield to hand.

abilities.name: Magic Block
abilities.description: On successful spell save: block with shield, take no damage. Uses: WIS modifier per short rest.

abilities.name: Supreme Bastion
abilities.description: Gain all Walking Bastion features: +3 AC, +9 HP/level, +15 PA.

abilities.name: Combat Style
abilities.description: Choose 1: Destruction (crit range +1), Evasive (+2 AC), Agile (full mod off-hand), Duelist (+level damage one-hand), Precision (no throw disadvantage), Obstruction (taunted stacks on hit).

abilities.name: Adrenaline
abilities.description: Gain 3 AP now, lose 3 AP next turn. Uses: WILL modifier per long rest, max once per turn.

abilities.name: Combat Training
abilities.description: +5 to Lifting/Athletics/Reflex/Intimidation skill thresholds each, OR +15 to one.

abilities.name: Combat Maneuvers (Minor)
abilities.description: Choose 1 defensive (Parry/Block/Counterattack/Dodge) and 1 offensive (Whirlwind/Crippling Strike/Cull the Meek/Breaching Blow). Costs energy.

abilities.name: Indomitable Perseverance
abilities.description: Spend 1 perseverance stack to heal [(level)d10 + level * CONST mod]. Start with 2 stacks, regain on rest.

abilities.name: Combat Maneuvers (Medium)
abilities.description: Choose 1 defensive (Deflect/Volatile Shell/Barrier) and 1 offensive (Ruthless Barrage/Master Strike/Battering Ram).

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: Spending a perseverance stack also regains 20 energy.

abilities.name: Improved Fighter
abilities.description: Learn 1 additional minor offensive and 1 additional minor defensive maneuver.

abilities.name: Combat Maneuvers (Major Def)
abilities.description: Choose 1: Unfaltering Resolve, Impervious, Thrive on Pain. Cost 80 energy.

abilities.name: Combat Maneuvers (Major Off)
abilities.description: Choose 1: Overwhelming Power, Overpower, Steel Hurricane. Cost 80 energy.

abilities.name: Supreme Fighter
abilities.description: Know all combat maneuvers. Double energy pool.

shaolin.name: Shaolin
shaolin.fistDamageScaling: stat mod + 7 + 1d4 at level 1, +3 flat per level. Dice/mod multiplier increases at prof milestones.

abilities.name: Martial Master
abilities.description: Unarmed uses STR or DEX. Attack action strikes twice. Double stat mod vs 0 PA targets.

abilities.name: Natural Defence
abilities.description: AC = 10 + DEX mod + WILL mod. +1 at levels 5, 9, 13, 17.

abilities.name: Essence of Chakra
abilities.description: Leg Sweep (3 chakra: prone stacks), Push Kick (1: STR save or pushed 15ft), Iron Elbow (2: wounded 3d6, +1d6/level). DC = 8 + prof + WILL.

abilities.name: Defensive Arts
abilities.description: Reaction + 2 chakra: DEX save vs ranged (catch/half) or melee (deflect/half, CONST save to end enemy turn).

abilities.name: Step of the Wind
abilities.description: 1 chakra: walk on steep surfaces, over water (1 AP max), no AoO. Rest of turn.

abilities.name: Palm of Tranquillity
abilities.description: 3 chakra as part of attack: WILL save or silenced 1 round.

abilities.name: Calm Soul
abilities.description: Advantage on all saves, attacks against you have disadvantage, but your attacks have disadvantage. Until end of next turn. Free.

abilities.name: Spell Absorption
abilities.description: 5 chakra on successful spell save: absorb spell, take no damage, cast it on your turn using WILL. One stored spell max.

abilities.name: Grandmaster Techniques
abilities.description: 5 chakra each: Fists of Power (true damage 3 rounds), Ki Assault (mark + free attacks), Dragon Strike (27d10 fire on hit).

abilities.name: Chakra Master
abilities.description: Double chakra points. Spend chakra to remove negative effects (1 per effect, X for Xth level spell).

abilities.name: Blind Eyes
abilities.description: Gave up sight. Blindsight 10ft. Ranged attacks against you have advantage.

abilities.name: Master of Focus
abilities.description: Generate 10 focus/turn start, +15 on dealing damage, -5 on CC. Convert focus to temp HP (focus/4). Master of Focus 2 at level 14: 20/turn.

abilities.name: Natural Defence
abilities.description: AC = 12 + DEX mod + WILL mod. +1 at levels 5, 9, 13, 17.

abilities.name: Basic Focus Manoeuvres
abilities.description: 20 focus each: extra target, +1d10 damage, halve target MS, -1 AP cost (stacks 3x).

abilities.name: Focused Might
abilities.description: Attacks deal bonus damage equal to focus/10 (rounded up).

abilities.name: Advanced Focus Manoeuvres
abilities.description: 50 focus each: spinning weapon defense, wind gale (AoE force), shadow conversion.

abilities.name: Blind Perception
abilities.description: Ranged attacks no longer have advantage. Advantage on saves vs traps you can hear.

abilities.name: Eye of the Mind
abilities.description: 150 focus: truesight 100ft, advantage on all attacks, disadvantage on attacks against you. No focus gain. Special abilities: weapon throw+teleport, telekinesis, immaterial.

abilities.name: Body of the Martyr
abilities.description: Immune to decaying and disease. Age 10x slower.

abilities.name: Greater Focus Manoeuvres
abilities.description: 100 focus each: meteor strike (24d12 fire AoE), dark energy blast (46d12 shadow), storm stun (3 targets).

abilities.name: Unleash the Martyrs
abilities.description: Channel: spirits deal 26d10 spectral to all targets within 60ft. Once per long rest free, 200 focus after.

abilities.name: Focus Deity
abilities.description: Double focus generation.

abilities.name: Natural Defence
abilities.description: AC = 10 + DEX mod + WILL mod. +1 at levels 5, 9, 13, 17.

abilities.name: Sacred Hand
abilities.description: Direct (2 AP): heal [WILL mod + 3d10] (+1d10/level). Integrated (+1 AP to weapon attack): heal [3d10] (+1d10/level). +WILL mod at 5/9/13/17. 5x cost out of combat.

abilities.name: Numinous Strikes
abilities.description: Sacred Hand attack deals +1d4 true damage (+2d4/level). Doubled if half allies at full HP. Halved if half allies below max.

abilities.name: Steadfast Touch
abilities.description: 3x standard Sacred Hand healing. Uses: WILL modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Revered Meditation
abilities.description: Channel up to 3 turns: heal all allies within 30ft. Costs 2x sacred energy of single target heal. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Distant Aid
abilities.description: Gain 90ft range on targeted healing. Uses: 2x WILL modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Cleansing Hand
abilities.description: End a negative effect when healing. Cost varies: 50-1000 sacred energy depending on effect severity.

abilities.name: Quickened Aid
abilities.description: Double MS toward injured allies. Moving to severely injured ally: first 2 AP of movement free.

abilities.name: Sacramental Renewal
abilities.description: Revive creature dead within 5 min at 50% HP. 25% max sacred energy (or 50% to skip death stack in combat).

abilities.name: Apotheosis
abilities.description: Double steadfast touch and distant aid uses. Cleansing hand cost halved, no check required. Lifespan 10x.

abilities.name: Perfect Aiming
abilities.description: Archery training bonus doubled when targeting body parts (can't be easier than hitting the enemy).

abilities.name: Ballistic Shots
abilities.description: Within 50ft: double modifier and dice damage. Within 15ft: double all damage. Stacks with high ground/power shot.

abilities.name: High Ground
abilities.description: Bonus damage per attack when you have high ground.

abilities.name: Combat Tactics
abilities.description: Choose 1: Giant Slayer (+1d10 per size difference), Flurry of Arrows (hit all enemies within 5ft of target), Crippling Shots (-10 MS).

abilities.name: Power Shot
abilities.description: -5 attack for +X damage. If attack goes below AC, it misses entirely.

abilities.name: Bow Mastery
abilities.description: +2 attack with all bows and crossbows.

abilities.name: Tactical Retreat
abilities.description: Jump to point within 60ft. Resets on ranged weapon crit.

abilities.name: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Double range this turn. Ballistic shots can add base damage again at 200ft+. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Sky Shots
abilities.description: Every attack jumps high into the sky, granting high ground (bonus damage + advantage).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WIS-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: Arcane Tracker
abilities.description: Add both survival and arcana modifiers when tracking or identifying spell effects.

abilities.name: Magic Quiver
abilities.description: Holds [5 + level] magic arrows. Refill on long rest. Minor arrows: Pure, Fire, Void, Lightning.

abilities.name: Craft Minor Magic Arrows
abilities.description: Create minor magic arrows during rest.

abilities.name: Arrow Splash
abilities.description: Magic arrow effects splash to adjacent targets.

abilities.name: Craft Major Magic Arrows
abilities.description: Create major magic arrows during rest.

abilities.name: Magical Bow
abilities.description: Level 20 capstone ability.

abilities.name: Animal Companion
abilities.description: Train an animal companion that acts on your turn sharing your AP pool. Different animal types have different stats and abilities. Companion has an HP threshold at which it auto-flees.

abilities.name: Traps (1)
abilities.description: Craft and place traps (max 3 at a time, 1 min duration). Trap DC = 8 + 2*prof. Options: Explosive Trap (15ft AoE, [4d6 + level*2d6] fire, DEX save), Bear Trap (root, STR save each turn), Blinding Trap (10ft AoE blind 3 rounds, CONST save).

abilities.name: Flanking Buddy
abilities.description: Deal X bonus damage to a target within 5ft of and damaged since last round by your animal companion.

abilities.name: Telepathic Communication
abilities.description: Communicate with your animal companion through simple thoughts within 60ft.

abilities.name: Trap Upgrade
abilities.description: Placed traps last 10 minutes and allies are not affected by them.

abilities.name: Traps (2)
abilities.description: New traps: Bait Trap (companion rushes and attacks with advantage, CONST save or prone), Blink Trap (2-point teleporter, 200ft max), Freeze Trap (frozen, CONST save to end).

abilities.name: Trap Upgrade (2)
abilities.description: Place up to 5 traps at a time, lasting up to 1 hour.

abilities.name: Trap Upgrade (2)
abilities.description: Traps last 1 hour and you can place up to 5 at a time.

abilities.name: Linked Souls
abilities.description: If either you or your companion would take lethal damage, the one hit can make a CONST save (DC = 8 + killer's level) to survive at 1 HP instead.

abilities.name: Traps (3)
abilities.description: New traps: Death Trap (target takes 5d10 bonus physical damage from you and companion for 3 rounds), Astral Trap (INT save or banished to astral plane with spirit clone of companion), Mass Stun Trap (20ft AoE, CONST save or stunned 1 round).

abilities.name: Trap Upgrade (3)
abilities.description: Place up to 10 traps at a time, lasting up to 24 hours.

abilities.name: Spirit Animal
abilities.description: Ritual transforms companion into a spirit animal with increased stats and new abilities. Can be summoned/unsummoned with a whistle. If it dies, it reconstructs in the astral plane in 24 hours.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Once per round, first damage to a surprised, unaware, or ally-adjacent foe deals bonus damage. If triggered by stealth/invisibility (not adjacency), bonus damage is tripled.

abilities.name: Silent Steps
abilities.description: Stealth check modifier increased by 2*proficiency.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Slice
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: deal [(level-2)*2+1]d6 bonus damage of attack type. Reduces initiative by 2. Free during surprise rounds.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Noxious Cut
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: apply [(level-2)*2+1]d4 envenomed stacks for 1 min. Reduces initiative by 3.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Scar
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: apply [level/2 rounded up] maimed stacks. Reduces initiative by 1.

abilities.name: Fatal Fixation
abilities.description: Mark a creature (0 AP). Active next turn. Next damage to marked target: roll 1d5 and multiply damage by result. Attacking others before triggering causes Revealed + Exposed for 3 rounds. 2 charges, regain on rest. Fixed Focus variant: always x5 but Exposed for 6 rounds, once per rest.

abilities.name: Swift Presence
abilities.description: After attacking, spend 2 AP to dash 1 AP of movement (no AoO) and hide. Can hide in half cover or out of line of sight. Once per round. Cost becomes 1 AP at level 17.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Poisonous Blade
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: apply [level/2 rounded up] poisoned stacks. Reduces initiative by 2.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Tongue Slit
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: apply [level/2 rounded up] silenced stacks. Reduces initiative by 4.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade - Wrist Cut
abilities.description: On hit vs lower-initiative target: apply [level/2 rounded up] disarmed stacks. Reduces initiative by 4.

abilities.name: Quick On Thy Feet
abilities.description: Add proficiency to initiative rolls.

abilities.name: Cut Tongue
abilities.description: Targets damaged by both Sneak Attack and Unseen Blade are silenced 3 turns. CONST save DC [8 + 2*prof] each turn to end early.

abilities.name: Assassin's Cloak
abilities.description: Stealth dice rolls of 10 or lower are treated as 11 (before bonuses).

abilities.name: Trained Agility
abilities.description: Add DEX modifier twice to initiative rolls instead of once.

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: When you successfully hide, you become invisible as long as you have half cover or are standing still. Truesight and reveal-invisibility spells still detect you.

abilities.name: Cutthroat
abilities.description: First time you damage a creature, if Cut Tongue would activate, you can instead deal 100 additional true damage.

abilities.name: Unseen Blade (16d10)
abilities.description: Unseen Blade Slice damage scales to 16d10 at level 20.

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Damaging a target from behind deals bonus damage. Can only trigger once per attack.

abilities.name: Experienced Thief
abilities.description: Proficient in thievery (if already proficient, gain additional proficiency). Add proficiency value to thievery checks.

abilities.name: Shrewd Eyes
abilities.description: Add DEX modifier directly (flat value, not dice) to perception checks.

abilities.name: Cunning Tongue
abilities.description: Add proficiency to deception and intimidation checks.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Reaction: increase AC by proficiency for 1 attack. Requires medium or no armor. Uses: DEX modifier per short rest.

abilities.name: Danger Sense
abilities.description: Advantage on all perception checks to detect hidden creatures or traps.

abilities.name: Elusive
abilities.description: Successful saving throws against spells or attacks have no effect on you, even if the spell states otherwise.

abilities.name: Sabotage
abilities.description: Sleight of hand vs passive perception from backstab position. On success, target's next attack/spell has randomized outcome (d10: 1-4 fizzles, 5-7 hits ally, 8-9 backfires, 10 normal). Uses: DEX modifier per target.

abilities.name: Expert Eyes
abilities.description: Sense invisible creatures within 30ft (not exact location). Sense magically protected treasure and gold piles over 100 within 200ft.

abilities.name: Break Magic
abilities.description: Thievery check to undo a magic seal/glyph/protection on an object. One attempt per object; failure alerts the caster.

abilities.name: Reliable Talent
abilities.description: All ability check rolls of 10 or lower are treated as 11. Attacks that apply Backstab deal true damage.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: CHA-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: One With the Shadows
abilities.description: Advantage on stealth in darkness. Considered invisible in darkness unless foes have truesight, darkvision, or light is shed on you.

abilities.name: Shadow Clone
abilities.description: Summon a shadow copy at exactly 30ft range. Clone mimics movement and attacks (dealing shadow damage) but not abilities cast through objects. Lasts 1 min. Uses: CHA modifier per long rest. Clone follows a 5-step cycle for ability/thrown weapon targeting.

abilities.name: Twofold Assault
abilities.description: If you and your shadow both damage a foe with the same attack/ability, the foe takes X extra damage (shadow or weapon type, your choice).

abilities.name: Shadow Strikes
abilities.description: Dealing damage while in darkness deals X extra shadow damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Exchange
abilities.description: Swap places with your shadow clone. Uses: CHA modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Dark Assault
abilities.description: Summon 4 shadow clones instead of 1 (forming an X centered on you). All mimic your attacks and you can Shadow Exchange with any of them.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Summon Spirit
abilities.description: Summon a spirit within 15ft. Choose: Earth (tanky, slow), Fire (ranged damage, fragile), Lightning (fast, lethal, fragile), or Spectral (balanced wolf). Spirit uses your AP. Unsummon with 6 AP channel, resummon in same state. If spirit dies, must recharge via rest.

abilities.name: Converging Forces
abilities.description: Gain 1 Dark Energy when you and your spirit both deal damage in the same turn (different targets, separate instances). Lose half (rounded up) if no Dark Energy gained in a round.

abilities.name: Spirit Exposure
abilities.description: Consume 1 Dark Energy when dealing your spirit's damage type (not through spirit): target takes [1d4, +1d4/level] bonus damage from spirit abilities until end of next turn.

abilities.name: Spirit Rush
abilities.description: Consume 1 Dark Energy on Spirit Unlock/Enhancement cast: Earth moves 30ft, Fire disengages, Lightning hides for 1 AP, Spectral reduces next ability cost by 1 AP.

abilities.name: Spirit Shield
abilities.description: Consume 1 Dark Energy on Spirit Command cast: grant spirit [1d6, +1d6/level] temp HP for 1 round.

abilities.name: Health Transfer
abilities.description: Consume up to 20% max HP to restore same to spirit, or consume up to 20% spirit max HP to restore half to you.

abilities.name: Spirit Exposure (1d8)
abilities.description: Spirit Exposure bonus damage scales to 1d8 at level 4, 2d8 at 10, 4d8 at 16.

abilities.name: Energy Burst
abilities.description: If you deal damage with spirit, yourself, and a spirit weapon/energy to the same target in one turn, regain X AP. Can proc on multiple different targets.

abilities.name: Summon Spirit (2)
abilities.description: Learn to summon a second type of spirit.

abilities.name: Masterful Calling
abilities.description: First 2 AP spent commanding your spirit each turn are free.

abilities.name: Twin Death
abilities.description: Can have up to 2 spirit weapons/energies active at a time (concentrate on two spirit weapon spells).

abilities.name: Summon Spirit (3)
abilities.description: Learn to summon a third type of spirit.

abilities.name: Spirit Master
abilities.description: Summon spirits unlimited times per long rest (still only one at a time). Energy Burst also restores up to 500 mana.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Dark Knowledge
abilities.description: Add proficiency to lore/arcana checks related to the occult.

abilities.name: Reveal Dead
abilities.description: Summon a corpse from the ground at a point within 30ft. Uses: WILL modifier.

abilities.name: Demon Form
abilities.description: Transform into a demonic form for 3 turns total. Spell modifier +[necromancer level/2 rounded up] for damage only. Immune to own spells. Dark aura deals 2d6 shadow damage (+2d6 at levels 5/9/13/17) to creatures starting/ending turn within 5ft.

abilities.name: Mark of the Necromancer
abilities.description: Mark a corpse preventing alteration by others unless they cast remove curse of level > your level. Spirit cannot leave the body unless you allow it or mark is removed.

abilities.name: Spirit Absorption
abilities.description: On kill, absorb the spirit (destroying it) for 10 temp HP (+10 at levels 5/9/13/17). Temp HP cannot exceed base HP. Lost on long rest. Doubled in Demon Form.

abilities.name: Spirit Sight
abilities.description: See and communicate with spirits still roaming the plane. Can use Spirit Absorption on spirits you find.

abilities.name: Demonic Departure
abilities.description: On leaving Demon Form: deal 2x spell modifier shadow damage to all within 10ft, +2x spell modifier per 50+ damage instance dealt in demon form. Double damage if you have Spirit Absorption temp HP. Damage threshold increases by 7/level past 8.

abilities.name: Persisting Corpses
abilities.description: Corpses remain intact after your first spell on them (2 spells per corpse before consumed).

abilities.name: Strengthen Inner Demon
abilities.description: Demon Form lasts up to 2 min. Dark aura can force STR save or knockback 1d4*10ft. Shadow damage has 25% chance to raise a corpse. Spend 2 AP for physical damage resistance until next turn (once/turn).

abilities.name: Cursed Flight
abilities.description: Gain 10ft flying speed. Ending turn in air costs 40% max HP. In Demon Form: speed tripled, penalty halved to 20%.

abilities.name: Mass Corpse Manipulation
abilities.description: Corpse-targeting spells affect up to 3 corpses simultaneously at no additional AP or mana cost.

abilities.name: Archdemon
abilities.description: Demon Form lasts up to 1 hour. Shadow damage ignores resistance and MA. Immune to shadow damage, resistant to physical. 2 AP physical resistance now grants immunity.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: WILL-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Faith of the Cursed
abilities.description: Proficient in Religion checks to call your overlord. Double proficiency on those checks, and proficiency limit raised to 16 (instead of 13).

abilities.name: Dark Reserves
abilities.description: Casting spells adds spell level to a stack (max 10). Consume 2x spell level in stacks to cast a spell for free and empowered. Stacks reset on leaving combat.

abilities.name: Hellish Pain
abilities.description: Damaging a foe with both your spell and your overlord's spell (different damage types) in the same turn deals X bonus true damage. Once per turn.

abilities.name: Avatar of the Overlord
abilities.description: Spells cast by your overlord can originate from an avatar spawned in any empty spot within 30ft of you. Spell direction and range apply from the avatar.

abilities.name: Desperate Call
abilities.description: Call overlord to cast a known warlock spell you have access to (free mana). Or attempt DC 20 Religion for stronger aid, but max HP reduced by 20/level (regain 5 max HP/level per long rest). Uses: WILL modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Overlord Reserves
abilities.description: Dark Reserves max stacks increased to 20. Stacks no longer reset on rest or leaving combat.

abilities.name: Overlord's Calling
abilities.description: Call your overlord to replace you for up to 1 min. You are frozen in a safe plane; overlord avatar fights in your place (you control it). After use, overlord assigns a quest before ability can be used again. Quest difficulty increases each use.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Sense the Arcana
abilities.description: Automatically sense magical objects nearby (no material walls). On touch, detect magical properties. Sharpen senses for 10 min to learn exact location and nature. Uses: INT modifier.

abilities.name: Empower Magic - Apprentice
abilities.description: Gain 1 Empowerment stack per 20 mana spent (after spell resolves). Persist between combats, lost on long rest. Spend stacks to empower spells: Intensify (+2d4 dmg), Safeguard (protect 1 creature), Prolong (+1 turn duration), Expand (+5ft diameter), Echo (duplicate targeted spell to extra target). All stack.

abilities.name: Mana Burst
abilities.description: When casting a spell, add half the mana spent (rounded up) as bonus damage to one damage instance of that spell.

abilities.name: Meditation
abilities.description: During short rest, regain 1/4 total mana. Does not regenerate HP.

abilities.name: Empower Magic - Adept
abilities.description: Infuse spells with debuffs (cost doubled for multi-target spells). Options: Cursed (4 stacks, 7 emp), Ethereal (2 stacks, 5 emp), Silenced (2 stacks, 7 emp), Prone (2 stacks, 5 emp), Suffocating (3 stacks, 4 emp), Blinded (1 stack, 4 emp). All stack.

abilities.name: Arcane Overflow
abilities.description: After casting 7 different named spells, roll 1d4: Block(1) for 1 round, next damage ability deals double, Warded(1) for 1 round, or Hasted(2 AP, 20 MS) for 2 rounds. Required spell count decreases by 1 at level 11, then by 1 every 2 levels.

abilities.name: Empower Magic - Master
abilities.description: Costs 100 mana. Options: Wild Spell (cast random d12 spell), Ethereal Spell (WILL save or halved physical/doubled magic dmg), Banishing Spell (WIS save or banished 1 min), Transport Spell (CHA save or teleported 30ft), Combusting Spell (targets explode for 6d10 fire in 5ft).

abilities.name: Mana Burst (80/160)
abilities.description: Mana Burst can now spend 80 or 160 mana, dealing full mana spent as bonus damage.

abilities.name: Absolute Knowledge
abilities.description: Double total mana. Mana Burst deals damage equal to full mana spent (not half).

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Mind Probe
abilities.description: Proficient in Insight checks. Proficiency can raise the roll to any value (no cap at 13).

abilities.name: Mind Seeds
abilities.description: Successfully casting a spell on a target plants a mind seed. Max 10 seeds per creature.

abilities.name: Seeds Manipulation
abilities.description: Consume seeds for effects: Distraction (reaction, subtract 2x seeds from target's attack rolls for 1 turn), Thought Feed (heal for 2*mindbender level per seed consumed on attack), Mind Transportation (teleport target 5ft per seed consumed in chosen direction).

abilities.name: Seed Explosion
abilities.description: As part of an attack, explode all seeds in a target's brain dealing X true damage per seed.

abilities.name: Mana Sap
abilities.description: On damage, consume seeds to restore 20 mana per seed. +10 mana/seed at levels 9, 13, 17.

abilities.name: Mind Chain
abilities.description: Consume 4 seeds from 2 targets within 30ft of each other. Pulls them to 20ft apart and neither can move beyond 20ft of the other. Lasts 1 min. Certain spells can end it.

abilities.name: Mass Seed Explosion
abilities.description: Cast Seed Explosion on all targets within 120ft simultaneously.

abilities.name: Mind Swap
abilities.description: Consume 10 seeds. Target makes WILL save or you possess its body indefinitely. You control target with its stats/abilities; your body falls unconscious. Ends if you take 30%+ of your max HP as damage, bodies exceed 200ft apart, either dies, or you choose. On save, 5 seeds return. Target immune 24h after save or effect ends.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based major spellcasting.

abilities.name: Elemental Surface
abilities.description: Dealing elemental damage creates a puddle of that element beneath the target. AoE spells create puddles matching the AoE; single-target creates a 5ft circle. Fire/Ice/Poison/Lightning each create their respective puddle.

abilities.name: Elemental Cycle
abilities.description: After you personally deal all 4 elemental damage types (fire, ice, poison, lightning) to a target, it takes X true damage.

abilities.name: Elemental Path (1)
abilities.description: Choose 2 paths (changeable on level up). Eldur: fire dmg applies 1d8 burning (+1d8 at 8/12/16/20, stacks 3x). Kalt: ice dmg reduces MS by 10 for 1 turn (stacks 3x, 0 MS = 4d6 ice, +4d6 at 8/12/16/20). Eitur: poison dmg makes target one level more vulnerable to poison. Eldingu: lightning dmg increases next lightning spell by 1d10 per previous lightning hit this turn (+1d10 at 8/12/16/20).

abilities.name: Elemental Resistance
abilities.description: After dealing elemental damage, become resistant to that damage type until start of your next turn. Only one resistance at a time (latest damage type applies).

abilities.name: Elemental Path (2)
abilities.description: Choose 2 paths (changeable on level up). Eldur: on fire dmg, CONST save or prone (1/short rest). Kalt: on ice dmg, CONST save or rooted (1/short rest). Eitur: on poison dmg, CONST save or blinded (1/short rest). Eldingu: on lightning dmg, WILL save or silenced (1/short rest). All last 1 turn.

abilities.name: Elemental Restoration
abilities.description: Elemental Cycle damage also restores mana equal to the true damage dealt. Every 4th spell costs no mana.

abilities.name: Swarm of the Elements
abilities.description: Elemental Cycle damage increases to 9d10 true damage.

abilities.name: Sovereign of the Elements
abilities.description: Learn spells from all classes if they deal only elemental damage. Elemental Cycle damage doubled. Single-target spells deal doubled dice damage.

abilities.name: Gland Mutations
abilities.description: Mutations grant: +10ft MS, 30ft darkvision (or +30 if already have it), and 2d10 HP/level healing after each fight.

abilities.name: Silvered Weapon
abilities.description: Wield an enhanced silvered melee weapon (STR-based). Deals silver damage: reduced damage to regular targets, increased damage to unholy creatures. Damage scales: 4/4/4/4/7/7/7/10/10/10/14/14/14/17/17/17/17/20/20/20.

abilities.name: Primordial Runes
abilities.description: Choose 4 runes. Prepare max 2 after each long rest. Spell mod = WIS. Options: Fire (shackle + burning hands), Telekinesis (heavy object bonus + 60ft teleport), Barrier (survive lethal + 3d6/level temp shield), Power (+1d6 true dmg + empowered melee strike), Blink (+1 AC + 30ft dash no AoO), Time (mark point, return within 3 rounds at avg HP, or 1 min rewind out of combat), Shadow (+prof stealth + shadow form through walls 1 min).

abilities.name: Sharpened Senses
abilities.description: Proficient in perception checks to find foes/hear enemies. Proficiency is doubled for these checks.

abilities.name: Basic Oils Craft
abilities.description: Apply oils to weapons (one at a time, only you can use). Oil of Decay (halve target's HP restoration 1 round), Oil of Wound (1d4 bonus physical per additional attack for 1 round, +1d4 at 5/9/13/17), Oil of Poison (1d8 bonus poison, +1d8 at 5/9/13/17).

abilities.name: Steady Mind
abilities.description: Advantage on all saving throws against possession or mind control.

abilities.name: Altered Body
abilities.description: STR and DEX permanently increased by 2 from mutations.

abilities.name: Rune Upgrade
abilities.description: All runes gain enhanced effects. Fire: doubled dice damage + 10ft range. Telekinesis: teleport 2 targets. Barrier: advantage on all saves while shield active. Power: +15 to hit, 3x modifier. Blink: double dashes, 3d10 true dmg through enemies. Time: return to max HP of the two, out-of-combat rewind is secret. Shadow: fully invisible, 4d10 shadow to other-plane creatures.

abilities.name: Advanced Oils Craft
abilities.description: Add effects to basic oils: Purging (prevent curse transfer 1 round), Grounding (prevent plane teleportation 1 round), Tranquillity (prevent rage/enrage next turn), Banishing (prevent resurrection).

abilities.name: Advanced Mutations
abilities.description: Gain resistance to one damage type (except true). Meditate 4 hours instead of sleeping (half-awake, dulled senses).

abilities.name: Perfected Hunter
abilities.description: Access all runes and have them all prepared at all times.

abilities.name: Essence Drain
abilities.description: Choose one damage type (light, spectral, or pure). Weapon attacks deal +X damage of that type. Bonus increases by X for each unholy tribe first kill (demon, wraith, undead, abomination, cursed-one).

abilities.name: Marks of Torment (1)
abilities.description: Cast curses (1 curse, 1 AP, 30ft range, max 2 active). Spell DC = 8 + prof + WIS. Options: Mark of the Tormentor (triple Essence Drain dmg 1 min), Exhaustion (all AP used = prone; unused AP lost, 1 min), Haste (regain 1 AP per hit, max 3/turn, 1 min), Pursuit (double MS, must hit chosen target or rooted, advantage on attacks vs target, 1 min), Challenger (if target dies next round: full HP heal + double Essence Drain 1 min; if survives: stunned 1 round + 2d8*level true dmg).

abilities.name: Power Absorption (1)
abilities.description: Absorb power from one unholy tribe (1/short rest, 1 min). Wraith: pass through 15cm walls, attack lower armor. Cursed-One: +7 melee dmg (+16 at 5/9/13/17). Abomination: telepathy 60ft, advantage on attacks vs creatures damaged by them. Demon: 1d12 fire + 1d12 shadow aura 5ft (doubles at 5/9/13/17). Undead: CONST save vs death (DC 5, +5 each use, not vs light/silver/true).

abilities.name: Essence Hunger
abilities.description: Heal for half the damage dealt by Essence Drain (rounded down).

abilities.name: Power Absorption (2)
abilities.description: Once per short rest. Wraith: [level]d10 psychic, WILL save or frightened 3 turns. Cursed-One: [level]d8 poison, WIS save or mad 3 turns. Abomination: CHA save or charmed 3 turns, or [level]d12 psychic on save. Demon: WIS save or [level]d6 fire/turn + silenced 1 min (repeat save). Undead: 30ft AoE CONST save or prone + weakened 1 round + decaying 1 min.

abilities.name: Marks of Torment (2)
abilities.description: Cost 2 curses, 4 AP. Can have 3 marks active (max 2 from tier 2). Options: Confusion (WIS save or attack random creature 1 min), Betrayal (all within 30ft WIS save or attack the target 1 round), Astral Bind (prevent dashing/teleporting/plane shifting 1 min, 1d8 true/level if tried), Gluttony (1 AP movement/turn, excess movement = 6d8 true dmg, 1 min), Stalker (attack from 60ft, teleport to target, attacks can't miss using range, 1 min).

abilities.name: Power Absorption (3)
abilities.description: Greater Wraith: CHA save or possess target 1 min (learn all knowledge). Greater Cursed-One: control curse form (+phys resist, +2 STR/DEX, +60ft darkvision). Greater Abomination: permanent body change (scales: +2 AC/15 PA/15 MA, muscles: +15 weapon dmg, or tentacles: 100 shadow dmg + CHA save teleport 30ft). Greater Demon: flying, fire/shadow resist, weapon damage type choice. Greater Undead: create phylactery for 1 free resurrection.

abilities.name: Marks of Torment (3)
abilities.description: Cost 3 curses, 3 AP. Can have 1 tier-3 mark plus existing 3. Mark for Death: all damage to target doubled until start of next turn. Mark for Shatter: target's damaging abilities deal half damage for 1 round.

abilities.name: Ethereal Form
abilities.description: Switch between Mortal and Ethereal Form. First transform per turn is free, additional costs 1 AP. Ethereal: resistant to physical, vulnerable to magic, attacks deal spectral damage. Attacking in both forms in one turn makes next transform free.

abilities.name: Spectral Craft
abilities.description: Create small magical objects at will. 1-hour ritual to create a Spectral Weapon (any weapon type at or below your level). Use any stat for attack/damage rolls. Deals physical in Mortal Form, spectral in Ethereal. Ignores heavy property. Bound to you.

abilities.name: Phantom Assault
abilities.description: After dealing both physical and spectral damage to a target, it takes X additional true damage.

abilities.name: Sense Spirits
abilities.description: In Ethereal Form, sense unholy tribes (undead, wraith, demon, abomination, cursed-one) within 300ft. Know types present but not numbers/locations. Advantage on checks to locate sensed beings.

abilities.name: Spectral Attacks (1)
abilities.description: Cost 10 energy, 0 AP. Mortal Form applies Mark, Ethereal consumes it. Decoy Hit (halve damage + mark / consume for crit). Spectral Afterblow (1 AP + mark / consume for +3 AP). Ghost Blink (+30ft ranged + mark / teleport to target). Duality Verdict (2 AP heal 2d10/level + mark / 1 AP: deal healed amount as true dmg to both).

abilities.name: Phantasmagorical Shape (1)
abilities.description: Enter a stance for 3 turns. Switching costs 25% energy, returning to normal costs 50%. Options: Ravaging (double all damage, no healing/shielding), Precision (double prof for attack rolls, halved speed), Bloodthirst (heal 50% of damage dealt, must switch forms each turn or take 25% max HP true dmg).

abilities.name: Spectral Attacks (2)
abilities.description: Cost 30 energy. Suspend (mortal: float target 20ft, rooted / ethereal: slam down +1d4/level, prone). Vital Strike (mortal: heal 2d10/level + mark / ethereal: deal healed as true dmg, costs 2 AP each). Spectral Sweep (mortal: 1 AP, STR save or push 15ft + mark / ethereal: 3 AP, pull all marked targets and free attack each).

abilities.name: Spectral Eyes
abilities.description: Peek into the spectral realm without fully transforming. Only eyes become ghostly, granting spirit sight and Sense Spirits without Ethereal Form modifiers.

abilities.name: Phantasmagorical Shape (2)
abilities.description: New stances (3 turns). Spiritbane (attacks lower target CHA mod by 1, max -5; advantage on CHA/WIS saves; doubled energy costs). Angelic (immune to curses/poison/plague/decay; weapon is magical; PA and MA drop to 0). Steady Mind (immune to mind alteration and unwilling plane teleportation; doubled INT/WIS for checks/saves; disadvantage on STR/DEX/CON saves).

abilities.name: Plane Shifter
abilities.description: Changing between Mortal and Ethereal Form no longer costs anything (all transforms are free).

abilities.name: Spectral Attacks (3)
abilities.description: Cost 70 energy. Spectral Impale (mortal: 3 AP, weapon copies from earth hit all within 20ft, mark those hit / ethereal: 0 AP, ghost copies mimic your attacks on marked targets at half dmg). Spectral Recall (mortal: 0 AP, mark your position / ethereal: teleport back, optional 3 AP for 15ft radius 30d10 spectral explosion, CONST save for half). Spirit Banish (mortal: 1 AP, CHA save or mark / ethereal: on hit, consume mark to banish to spectral plane 1 min).

abilities.name: True Phantom
abilities.description: Exist in both planes simultaneously. Resistant to physical by default (not vulnerable to magic). All abilities usable regardless of form. Attacks deal physical or spectral at your choice.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: Dual Death
abilities.description: Double the AP cost of a spell to affect both weapons when dual wielding.

abilities.name: Magic Conversion
abilities.description: Choose one magic damage type permanently. Convert all attack damage (including bonuses) to that type on an attack. Uses: INT modifier per long rest.

abilities.name: Relentless Assault
abilities.description: At turn start, choose to relentlessly attack a foe (must be in range). Can only weapon attack that target, but full attack strikes an additional time. Extra strike deals no weapon damage but applies all effects and spell damage.

abilities.name: Mana Rush
abilities.description: When casting a buff/enhancement on yourself or weapon, consume 5*spell level extra mana to halve AP cost (rounded up, min 1 AP).

abilities.name: Mana Barrier
abilities.description: Toggle on/off. While active: attacks from 30ft+ have disadvantage, but all 30ft+ attacks (hit or miss) drain 30 mana.

abilities.name: True Evasion
abilities.description: While dodging/evading or attacks have disadvantage: successful spell saves = no damage; failed saves = half damage. If from Mana Barrier, mana is also drained by save-based spells.

abilities.name: Focus Recollection
abilities.description: On short rest, regain half total mana. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Spinning Death
abilities.description: Spin with both weapons, attacking all targets in range. All effects trigger. Uses: INT modifier.

abilities.name: Crush and Cast
abilities.description: First attack action each round lets you cast a 3rd-level or lower weapon buff for free (0 AP, 0 mana). Can use Mana Rush to apply to both weapons.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: Cautious Casting
abilities.description: When casting a spell, make up to X creatures immune to its damage and effects. Those creatures still count for Mass Destruction.

abilities.name: Mass Destruction
abilities.description: Spells deal X bonus damage for each target hit beyond 1. All creatures the spell attempts to affect count, even undamaged ones.

abilities.name: Comeback of the Arcanist
abilities.description: When you would take lethal damage, consume 1/4 total mana to survive with that amount as HP instead.

abilities.name: Arcane Veins
abilities.description: Activate a buff for 3 turns: your own spells heal you instead of damaging you. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Battle Concentration
abilities.description: When concentration/channelling would be interrupted by damage, continue casting instead. Uses: INT modifier.

abilities.name: Battle Frenzy
abilities.description: When Comeback of the Arcanist triggers, instantly cast a spell for free (0 AP, 0 mana), then the round continues.

abilities.name: Armageddon
abilities.description: Bouncing spells bounce 2 additional times. AoE and cone spells gain +10ft area. Targets in extended area or hit by last 2 bounces take double Mass Destruction damage.

abilities.name: Spellcasting
abilities.description: INT-based minor spellcasting.

abilities.name: Lasting Punishment
abilities.description: Weapon attacks and targeted spells apply Lasting Punishment stacks to the target. Stacks only accumulate on the same target with consecutive hits. Attacking a different creature resets stacks on the old target and applies 1 to the new one. Only main-hand attacks apply stacks when dual wielding.

abilities.name: Lasting Punishment - Rend
abilities.description: Damaging a creature with Lasting Punishment stacks deals [stacks * (level/2 rounded down)]d6 bonus damage of the same type. Applies once per ability cast.

abilities.name: Keen Mind
abilities.description: Add 3*proficiency bonus to Investigation checks (separate from normal proficiency, stacks even if already proficient).

abilities.name: Reflective Shield
abilities.description: When damaged by a targeted attack (not AoE), attacker takes X damage of their attack's type, ignoring armor. Increases by 2d12 per character level.

abilities.name: Vigor
abilities.description: When attacking a target with Lasting Punishment stacks, if the Rend bonus damage equals or exceeds the target's armor, ignore the target's armor entirely for that attack.

abilities.name: Lasting Punishment (2d6)
abilities.description: Rend damage scales to stacks * (level/2)d6 at this tier.

abilities.name: Focused Combat
abilities.description: Damage from targets without your Lasting Punishment stacks (while you have stacks on someone) is reduced by double your armor. Those attackers take double Reflective Shield damage.

abilities.name: Lasting Punishment (3d6)
abilities.description: Rend damage continues scaling at this tier.

abilities.name: Sentence Carried
abilities.description: On killing a target with Lasting Punishment stacks, recover 1/10 of total HP and mana per stack on the target.

abilities.name: Lasting Punishment (4d6)
abilities.description: Rend damage reaches maximum scaling.

abilities.name: Death Sentence
abilities.description: Requires all 6 Lasting Punishment stacks on target. Target is affected for 1 min: you deal double damage to it, are immune to damage from everyone else, but target takes half damage from others. Once per long rest.
